name: Steak Salad with Celery, Tomatoes, Blue Cheese & Garlic-Chive Crostini

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
6 sticks celery
3 (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Trim and chop chives into small pieces.
Place half of the garlic and half of the chives in a small bowl (reserving the rest for the next step); add oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the garlic-chive oil and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add remaining garlic and chives, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a large plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high; position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Halve tomatoes. Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Add mixed greens and blue cheese to the bowl and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Slice rolls in half and place on a large baking sheet pan, cut-side up; drizzle with the garlic-chive oil. Place in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut each round in half.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad, steak, and crostini between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
